children: subsidiary PowerSecure announced on Wednesday that it has entered into an agreement with Keel Infrastructure
to provide an integrated backup power and resiliency solutions for Keel’s data center campus in Moses Lake, Washington.

PowerSecure will design and deliver a customized standby power system that can expand as the campus grows. The solution will use its modular PowerBlocks systems and will also support peak shaving during periods of high electricity demand.
The project strengthens PowerSecure’s position in the data center market, where demand for reliable and scalable power solutions is increasing as digital infrastructure expands.
Moreover, both the companies established the partnership earlier this year and have since worked on system requirements and delivery timelines for the Moses Lake campus.

title: Southern Company unit signs data center power deal with Keel
